content:
olivia: Heads up — AcmeCorp on Dedicated reports duplicate charges + 5xx spike after upgrading to redwood-py 2.4.0 yesterday. Repro attached. :eyes:
kevin: can you paste the minimal repro and any request ids?
acme_ops: repro below, run twice quickly and you'll see two successful responses but double billing.
acme_ops: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., timeout_ms=5000)
resp = client.generate(model='rwd-small', prompt='hello')
print(resp.id)
```
support-liaison: do they set an idempotency key?
acme_ops: no, they didn't. This used to be OK (1 call), now we see retries when the upstream returns 502 and the SDK replays without setting Idempotency-Key header.
kevin: that matches a local trace I saw this morning — 2.4.0 introduced a retry default and also changed `session` -> `client` param handling; some callers end up not forwarding headers.
eng-mike: @kevin can you dump the trace?
deploy-bot: TRACE: req_id=xx-123 status=502 attempt=1; retry_delay=0.2; next_attempt=2
qa-jen: quick workaround for customers: set env `REDWOOD_PYSDK_RETRIES=0` or `export REDWOOD_PYSDK_RETRIES=0` before start, or pin to 2.3.7.
kevin: pip rollback command: `pip install 'redwood-sdk==2.3.7' --force-reinstall` — works for now.
olivia: we should offer AcmeCorp credits for the duplicate charges and escalate to billing. @billing please advise on refund workflow.
billing: we'll review once engineering confirms replayed requests. Please include full request_ids and timestamps.
eng-mike: filed ENG-5543 to restore header forwarding alias and to make retry default opt-in. I'll add a test ensuring `Idempotency-Key` is preserved when user provides any session/client object. :bug:
support-liaison: I'll notify the customer with the pin + env workaround and ask for the request ids.
acme_ops: thanks — sending the logs now, appreciate the fast response :thumbsup:
kevin: follow-up: also add note to release notes and a short migration guide. We'll cut a 2.4.1 patch if QA confirms fix.
qa-jen: starting a flakiness test matrix now (idempotency, retries, header forwarding). ETA 6h.
eng-mike: assigning engineer to hotfix, will try to get patch out in next 24h.
olivia: thanks team. keep this thread for comms with the customer until resolved.
